scope: Static inspection of historical collected files on Windows only. No phone commands, no ARM64 program/loader/library executed, no recompilation.
method: ELF64 section parser: dynamic, dynsym, versym, verneed, verdef. Versioned imports matched to the exact verneed provider and symbol version; unversioned imports matched to root plus recursive DT_NEEDED closure, accepting unversioned/default exports. Symbols must be externally visible and nonlocal. Counts/DT_NEEDED checked against saved LLVM raw reports. Unresolved weak imports listed separately.
